LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Meta.Meta__Description: Dashed, dotted and dash-dot (centre) edges on a vector shape, owned by Na__LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__.js and switched on from the Vectors panel. Off by default: a new line is solid. On, the Draw and Rectangle tools place a dashed edge, and the selected shape's edges take the same pattern. Section lengths are paper millimetres, the same unit as the projected linework dashes, so a dash measures the same on the sheet at any drawing scale. A Scale multiplies every section together - the control for 'how long the dashes are' without retuning each figure.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Meta.Meta__WhichKinds: Dashed is the general hidden or removed line. Dotted is a short mark and a gap, for concealed services and overhead extents. Dash-dot (centre) is long-short-long, the steelwork and setting-out centre line. Hidden is a tighter dashed, for small-scale plans. The millimetre figures here are the same alphabet as Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so a drawn centre line and a projected one can be made to match.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Meta.Meta__WhereScaleGoes: Scale is a multiplier on the stored millimetres at paint time, not a rewrite of them. 1 is the figures as typed; 0.5 halves every section; 2 doubles them. The millimetre fields stay put, so switching the kind reloads that kind's figures without losing the scale already chosen.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Meta.Meta__DashUnits: DashMm is the long on-stroke, GapMm the clear paper between strokes, MarkMm the short on-stroke of a dash-dot (ignored by dashed, dotted and hidden). All three are paper millimetres. The chrome writes them as SVG stroke-dasharray and as the PDF dash pattern, so the screen and the paper cannot drift apart.

LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the Dashed edges toggle starts from on a shape that has never had one, and what the Draw tool uses while nothing is selected. Off: a solid line. On: Dashed at scale 1, the millimetres of that kind.

LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Kinds.Kind__Note: General hidden or removed work. Dash on, gap off.
Concealed services, overhead extents. A short mark and a gap.
Long-short-long. The steelwork and setting-out centre line.
Tighter dash for small-scale plans and hidden edges.

LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far the millimetre fields and the scale slider may travel. A section below MinMm would vanish at print; one above MaxMm is a gap, not a dash.

LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__Description: The Vectors panel wording for the dashed-edge rows. The long explanations are tooltips rather than notes, so the rows cost no more panel height than the controls themselves.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__DashedTitle: Draw the edges dashed, dotted or dash-dot instead of solid. Off by default. On, a block opens for the pattern and how long its sections are - centre lines, hidden lines, overhead extents.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__KindTitle: Dashed is a regular hidden line. Dotted is a short mark. Dash-dot is the centre line (long-short-long). Hidden is a tighter dashed.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__ScaleTitle: Stretches every section together. 1 is the millimetres as typed; 0.5 halves them; 2 doubles them. The millimetre fields themselves stay put.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__DashTitle: How long the on-stroke is, in paper millimetres, before the scale is applied.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__DotTitle: How long each mark is, in paper millimetres, before the scale is applied.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__GapTitle: The clear paper between strokes, in millimetres, before the scale is applied.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__MarkTitle: The short stroke of a dash-dot (centre) line, in paper millimetres, before the scale is applied.
LayoutEditor__LineStyleTool__Labels.Labels__PreviewTitle: The pattern as it will print, at the current scale.
